title: How to Fish is the latest Steam indie sensation, selling 1 million copies in just two days
content:
If you've browsed the frontpage of Steam in the last few days, you'll no doubt have come across How to Fish, the debut project from developer Dazed Games. The co-op fishing game released on 20th August, and just three days later, its developer announced it had sold 1 million copies.
